gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement (trimmed pp6-7) prints total revenues 1,754,305: General 1,097,049, Street 309,214, LB840 326,936, CDBG 0, Other Governmental 21,106. Net +20,130 - 5,109 = +15,021, which equals schedule 1,769,326 - statement 1,754,305. Every line is as printed; no detail fix.
